project.description:
Loads GRCz11 gene start/end coordinates from NCBI into sequence_feature_chromosome_location_generated, under location source 'NCBIStartEndLoader'.
Runs server_apps/data_transfer/NCBIStartEnd/NCBIStartEnd.pl, which downloads GCF_000002035.6_GRCz11_feature_table.txt.gz from NCBI RefSeq, keeps rows where feature=gene on the Primary Assembly with numeric coordinates, then loadNCBIStartEnd.sql deletes every existing NCBIStartEndLoader row and re-inserts by joining the file's NCBI Gene IDs to db_link on ZDB-FDBCONT-040412-1.
Because it rebuilds from current db_link on every run, its rows cannot carry a stale gene/accession pairing forward - unlike Load-NCBI-GFF3-File, whose upsert is keyed on accession alone and never revisits the gene. That is why ZFIN-10461's reconciliation is scoped to NCBILoader and not to this source.
NOT the same job as Load-NCBI-GFF3-File: this one is GRCz11 and parses a RefSeq feature table; that one is GRCz12tu and parses a GFF3.
Caveat: GRCz11 has been retired by NCBI into all_assembly_versions/suppressed/. A suppressed assembly is not re-annotated, so the input file is frozen (mtime 2024-09-12) and each run re-loads the same 2024 coordinates. If GRCz11 start/end positions are being retired at ZFIN, retire this job rather than keep it pointed at a suppressed assembly.
Schedule comes from server_apps/jenkins/trigger.production.properties (Load-NCBIStartEndPositions=2 22 * * 5, i.e. weekly, Friday 22:02).
History: failed silently every week from 2025-05-23 until 2026-09-01. NCBI had moved the assembly path, and the script's error handler called ZFINPerlModules->sendMailWithAttachedReport without loading the module, so the failure email was never sent - only a red build.
